rules.name: Scrap Code Roar
rules.description: Vehicle, Walker and Automata units always resolve Shooting Attacks against this unit as Snap Shots if they are within 12” of this unit.

rules.name: Warp Infusion
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, you may select 1 Daemon Engine within 6” of Vashtorr at the beginning of the Shooting Phase or Combat Phase. In the Shooting Phase, all weapons the chosen unit are equipped with gain +1 to their Strength characteristic. In the Combat Phase, the Strength (S) characteristic of the chosen unit is increased by +1. These effects last until the end of the Phase.

rules.name: Plague Furnace
rules.description: At the start of the Combat Phase, all enemy units within 3” of this unit take D3+3 automatic hits. These hits are resolved at Strength 1, AP- with the Poison (4+) special rule. Saves may be taken as normal.

rules.name: Path of Ascension
rules.description: Once per game, if the enemy warlord would be slain and removed from play as a result of attacks made by this model, you may remove this model from the battlefield. Before removing the model, place a single Daemon Prince unit within 3” of its location. Your warlord counts as having been slain.

rules.name: Merchant Connections
rules.description:
A Dark Master with this upgrade gains the Master-Crafted special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.
• A Dark Master with this upgrade may exchange their Autopistol for one of the following:
o Fusion Pistol for 15pts.
o Shuriken Catapult for 2pts.
o Splinter Rifle for 2pts.
o Pulse Rife for 3pts.
o Pulse Pistol for 1pts
• A Dark Master with this upgrade may take one of the following:
o Agonizer for 10pts.
o Dire Sword for 10pts.
o Plasma Sword for 5pts.

rules.name: Daemonic Infusion
rules.description: A Dark Master with this upgrade gains the Daemon special rule. In addition, the unit gains +1 to its Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics.

rules.name: Fallen Noble
rules.description: A Dark Master with this special rule gains the Stubborn special rule. In addition, they gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Locus of Entropy
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit gain a 5+ Invulnerable save. In addition, enemy units that arrive via Deep Strike within 12” of this model suffer -1 to their roll when determining if they will arrive.

rules.name: Scarp Code Fragment
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to its Invulnerable Save. In addition, they can re-roll 1 Dice when performing the Leadership Test to perform a Machine Rite.

rules.name: Mechadentrite Nest
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains +D6 to its Attacks (A) Characteristic at the start of each Combat Phase.

rules.name: Scarp Code Fragment
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Tank Hunter special rule. In addition, Vehicle, Knight, Aircraft and Titan type units which target a unit with this upgrade in the Shooting Phase always conduct their Attack as Snap Shots.

rules.name: Corrupted Blood
rules.description: When a model with this special rule and removed from play, before it is removed from Play all enemy units within 6” take a number of automatic hits equal to the equipped models Wounds (W) characteristic + 3. The Strength of the hits is equal to the equipped models Toughness (T) characteristic. The AP of the hits are resolved at AP6. Saves may be taken as normal.

rules.name: Disciplined Commander
rules.description: During deployment, you may select a single friendly unit to gain the Scout or Outflank special rules.

rules.name: The Blood Armour
rules.description: This wargear grants a 2+ Armour save. Enemy units which make attacks against this unit in the Combat Phase while it is not attached to a friendly unit gain the Gets Hot! Special rule on all Melee weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Master of the Blood Pact
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all Cultist Mob units in your army gain +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS), Weapon Skill (WS), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics.

rules.name: Mindless
rules.description: This unit automatically passes all Pinning tests. When this unit fails a Panic test, it takes D3 automatic wounds instead of performing a Fall Back move. Saves may be made as normal against these wounds.

rules.name: Chaos Hound
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) and Furious Charge special rules.

rules.name: Cocktail of Excess
rules.description: This unit gains the Sprint (1) and Sudden Strike (1) special rules.

rules.name: Infectious Diseases
rules.description: Any enemy unit within 3” gains -1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic.

rules.name: Poison Weapons
rules.description: All melee type weapons the unit is equipped with gains the Poinson (4+) special rule.

rules.name: Mutant Rabble
rules.description:
At the start of the battle, during deployment but before the first turn begins, each unit in your army with this special rule must roll a D3:
1. Extra Appendages: The unit gains +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.
2. Acute Senses: The unit gains the Scout special rule and immediately performs a Scout move.
3. Horrific Disfiguration: The unit gains the Fear (2) special rule.

rules.name: Gore Tanks
rules.description:
In the Combat Phase this unit may activate its Gore Tanks. Select one of the following effects:
• This unit gains +1 to its Attacks (A) Characteristic until the end of the phase.
• Or, once per game, Immediately summon 1 unit of Bloodletters from Codex – Chaos Daemons to add to your army. This summoned unit is placed within 8” of this unit and may be placed in combat and may fight this Combat Phase. The Gore Monger unit is then immediately slain and removed from play.

rules.name: Skewered
rules.description: After resolving a Shooting Attack with a weapon that has this special rule, the model equipped with this weapon may move D6” towards the target (and may enter Engagement Range, ignoring the normal restrictions for ending a move within 3” of a target). In addition, Monster, Walker, Automata, Knight and Titan units that suffer an unsaved wound from this unit may not make Retreat Moves in their next Movement Phase.

rules.name: Putrid Explosion
rules.description: When a Plague Ogryn model in this unit is slain and removed from play in any phase, all units within 6” of this unit that do not have the Nurgle Keyword, take D6+2 Strength 5 automatic hits which are resolved at AP-. Wound rolls and Save rolls are made as normal against these hits.

rules.name: Breach the Veil
rules.description:
When this power is successfully cast, you can select 1 of the following effects.
1. Place 1 Warp Breach token (using a 25mm base token) within 12” of the Psyker.
2. Move 1 Warp Breach token D6” in a direction of your choice.


Friendly Daemon units may arrive from Reserves wholly within 6” of a Warp Breach token. In addition, at the end of the Shooting Phase, each unit within 3” of a Warp Breach token takes D6 Strength D6, APD6 automatic hits.

rules.name: Unsanctioned
rules.description: This unit always suffers a Perils of the Warp result on any result of a doubles when attempting to Cast Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons.

rules.name: Daemonic Lightning Rod
rules.description: When a model in this unit is slain as a result of a Perils of the Warp, before removing the model, summon 1 Herald of Nurgle, Herald of Khorne, Herald of Slaanesh or Herald of Tzeentch within 3” of this model. If the model had a Mark of Chaos, the summoned unit must also have the same Keywords.

rules.name: Cabal
rules.description: If this unit includes more than 1 model, it may deployed as a single unit or each model in the unit may be treated as a separate unit for the rest of the game with the Character special rule.

rules.name: Sword Masters
rules.description: A unit with this special rule gains the Parry special rule on all Melee weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Daemonic Infusion

rules.name: Ogryn Muscle
rules.description: The unit gains the following special rule while it includes an Ogryn Muscle model; Bulky (4), Relentless, Hammer of Wrath (1), Frenzy, Feel no Pain (6+).

rules.name: Extreme Mutations
rules.description:
At the start of the battle, during deployment but before the first turn begins, each unit in your army with this special rule must roll a D3:
1. Crushing Limbs: The unit gains the Crushing (5+) special rule on its Hideous Mutations.
2. Armored Hide: Models in this unit gain a 3+ Armor save.
3. Wings forms: The unit gains the Fly special rule.

rules.name: Gory Demise
rules.description: When a model with this special rule is slain in the combat phase and removed from play, enemy units within 3” take 2 Strength 5, AP5 automatic hits. Wound rolls and save rolls are made as normal.

rules.name: Las Gun Array
rules.description: If this unit is transporting Embarked models, it may make an additional 6 Attacks in the Combat Phase at its normal initiative with its Guard Crew Weapons.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This model can transport 6 Infantry models within it or 1 Earthshaker Carriage model.

rules.name: Firing Deck
rules.description: This unit may transport up to 20 Infantry type models and gains the Transport Keyword. The unit gains the Assault Vehicle special rule.

rules.name: Infernal Knight
rules.description: This unit may be taken as the only option in an Allied Detachment for your army and is taken to have filled all requirements of the Allied Detachment Force Organization Chart. However, you cannot include any additional units in your Allied Detachment Force Organization Chart.

rules.name: Garrison
rules.description: This model can garrison up to 22 Infantry models embarked within it. Models embarked within this Fortification may shoot in the shooting phase as normal, drawing all visibility and range from this unit’s hull.

sharedRules.name: Dark Overlord
sharedRules.description: A model with this special rule that is included in your army must be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: Human Shields
sharedRules.description: Each time a friendly Renegade & Heretics unit that is not the Knight or Titan type within 6” would suffer a wound or penetrating hit but before saves are made, you may roll a D6. On a 6+ the wound may be allocated to a unit with this special rule instead. If the unit with this special rule contains 11 or more models, you may allocate wounds to it unit on a 5+. This unit may not make any saves against the wound nor Feel no Pain rolls. Wounds allocated in this manner do not cause Panic or Pinning tests.A model with this special rule that is included in your army must be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: Infectious
sharedRules.description: All Melee weapons this unit is equipped with gain the Poison (4+) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Squad Tactics
sharedRules.description:
At the start of each of your turns, each unit in your army may select one of the following Squad Tactics to implement that round. The unit gains the benefit of the chosen Squad Tactic until the start of your next turn.


Las Overcharge: An Infantry unit may adopt this Squad Tactic. A unit which adopts this Squad Tactic treats all Lasguns they are equipped with as being Heavy 1. However, the Lasguns are treated as being Strength 4, AP4 with the Gets Hot! Special rule.


Grenade Volley: A unit which adopts this Squad Tactic gains the Barrage (x) special rule on all Grenade type weapons they are equipped with where (x) is equal to the number of models in the unit.


Breaching Move: A unit which adopts this Squad Tactic gains the Move Through Cover and Siege Attackers special rules.


Bayonet Wall: A unit which adopts this Squad Tactic gains the Counter Attack special rule. In addition, all Charges against a unit adopting this Squad Tactic are resolved as a Disordered Charges.


Suppressive Fire: Any unit may adopt this Squad Tactic. A unit which adopts this Squad Tactic gains the Pinning Special rule on all Shooting weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Hunting Rig
rules.description: A model equipped with a Hunting Rig has a 3+ Armor save. In addition, the Hunting Rig is equipped with 2 Lightning Claws and 2 Storm Bolters. The Equipped model increases its Strength (S) & Toughness (T) characteristics by 2 and its Wounds (W) Characteristics by 1. The Equipped model gains the Sprint (1), Fleet, Firing Protocols (2), Regeneration and Relentless special rules.

rules.name: Chemical Rebreather
rules.description: A model with this wargear may re-roll save rolls (Armour only) against wounds caused by weapons with the Poison (x) special rule.

rules.name: Drug Injector
rules.description: A model with this wargear can opt to inject combat Drugs at the start of the turn. Until the start of your next turn, the equipped model gains the Sprint (1), Furious Charge and Frenzy special rules. However, all weapons the model is equipped with gain the Gets Hot! Special rule.

rules.name: Vox Caster
rules.description: A unit with this Wargear automatically Rallies at the start of its Movement phase.

rules.name: Banner of the Apostate
rules.description: A unit that includes a model with this wargear gains +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Plate Armour
rules.description: This armour is comprised of a single heavy front plate with additional padding around. It provides a 3+ Armor Save but the equipped model cannot perform Sweeping Advances.

rules.name: Brute
rules.description: The Warlord gains +1 to their Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics. The Warlord gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule. If the Warlord already has the Hammer of Wrath (x) special rule, increase the value of (X) by 1.

rules.name: Charismatic Deceiver
rules.description: Any unit that can draw visibility to the Warlord or any attached unit may use the Warlords Leadership (LD) characteristic instead of their own when making Leadership Tests.

rules.name: Dark Magister
rules.description: The Warlord becomes a Psyker. They gain the Psyker (1) special rule. If the Warlord already has the Psyker (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: Aura of Dread
rules.description: All enemy units that can visibility to a Warlord with this trait must re-roll Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Infernal Quest
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait always counts as holding an Objective they are within 6” regardless of the number of enemy models contesting the Objective marker.

rules.name: Warp-Haunted Hull
rules.description: A model with this trait gains the Indomitable Spirit (2+) and Deny the Witch special rules.

rules.name: Possessed
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains the Daemon special rule and gains +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic.

rules.name: Infravision Goggles
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Night Vision special rule.

rules.name: Disc of Tzeentch
rules.description: A model with this wargear increases their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep strike special rules.

rules.name: Book of the Occult
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this Relic Wargear, at the start of your Movement Phase, may summon 1 Bloodletter, Daemonette, Plaguebearers, Nurglings or Pink Horrors from Codex – Chaos Daemons within wholly within 12” of the model with this relic and more than 3” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Seed of Corruption
rules.description: Once per game, when a model with this wargear would be slain, before they are removed from play, immediately summon 1 unit of Poxwalkers wholly within 12” of the bearer of the relic. This unit may be placed within 3” of enemy units.

rules.name: Chalice of Entropic power
rules.description:
At the start of each of your turns, a model with this relic must drink from the chalice, roll a D3.
1. Empowered: The bearer gains +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic.
2. Inured: The bearer gains +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic.
3. Swollen: The bearer gains +1 to the Wounds (W) characteristic.
All effects are cumulative, stack and last until the end of the game.

rules.name: Icon of Sin
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains the Fear (2) special rules. If they already have the Fear (x) special rules, improve the value of (x) by 1. Imperium units gain the Hatred special rule when attacking the bearer of this Relic and their attached unit. The bearer and their attached unit can re-roll Invulnerable save rolls of 1.

rules.name: Artifact of Lost Xeno-Heresy
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains a 3+ Invulnerable Save. In addition, once per game, they can gain the Arcing (6+) special rule on all weapons they are equipped with until the end of the current turn.

rules.name: Drain Will
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker. The target halves its Leadership (LD) characteristic until the end of the phase.
